Alternative patching mechanism and CPU feature detection details.
Task structure layout and register frame accessor for task stacks.
Timestamp counter mode values and permission checks.
Mitigation selection logic and enforcement effects.
Device tree, PCI and flattened tree behavior beyond inert helpers.
Compatibility syscall entry implementation and register use.
Page table isolation boot disable conditions.
Fault proof copy semantics and memory ordering guarantees.
Paravirtual clock writer side version protocol and flag production.
Queued spinlock full state machine and slow path behavior.

findings.text: A small inline helper installs the privileged stack pointer for the current context by forwarding the supplied value to the native low level loader.

Two inline cache hint helpers cover read and write intent. Each chooses between a base encoding and an alternate encoding based on a processor feature test applied to the caller memory operand. Availability macros advertise generic and write prefetch support with build dependent base selection, and a memory layout hook is enabled.
Per CPU topology identity can be queried by CPU number for last level cache, second level cache, and core through inline accessors over per CPU topology state.

Initial thread state has two build variants, one seeding a privileged stack top derived from the init stack minus reserved padding plus a kernel code segment, the other seeding a stack pointer from the top of the init kernel stack. Helpers expose the init stack top, a task stack top derived from its register frame, and instruction and stack pointers from a task frame. The unmapped base is the page aligned third of the task size.
Timestamp counter access mode is read and written through get and set macros that forward to dedicated mode helpers.
Boot time idle selection offers four modes: no override, halt, no monitor wait, and poll.

Two enumeration families describe selectable mitigations. One covers L1 terminal fault with off, automatic, flush variants with warning and SMT qualifications, and full plus forced full. The other covers microarchitectural data sampling with off, automatic, full, and virtual machine write verify.

Several optional hooks are inert in these fragments: microcode check, page table isolation boot check, device tree add, PCI init, flattened tree config fetch, paravirtual lock init, monitoring context free, and the fallback scheduler and CPU detection helpers. One thread area variant forwards to the 64 bit arch control helper while the other succeeds without action. The CPU zero paravirtual time accessor and monitoring context allocation both yield null.

Compatibility entry points for 32 bit system call and sysenter are null, the device tree IO APIC indicator and the Xen default idle indicator are zero, and resource control uses an all ones sentinel for empty class of service.

The 32 bit trap frame preserves general registers plus segment registers held as narrow values with padding, an original accumulator slot for vector or error information, and a return frame with instruction pointer, code segment, flags, stack pointer and stack segment. High portions of segment slots may be left undefined on some CPUs but are ignored on return.

Flexible event delivery defines two 64 bit descriptor extensions. One packs code selector with privilege level and branch tracking state. The other packs stack selector with interrupt enable, software event, non maskable, vector, type, enclave, 64 bit mode, nesting, and causing instruction length attributes. The 64 bit trap frame holds preserved registers, clobbered registers, a number or error slot that always carries an error code under flexible delivery, and a return frame where code and stack selectors appear as unions of narrow, wide, or extension views.

Register frame helpers expose and mutate return value, instruction pointer, frame pointer, user and kernel stack pointers, and current user stack pointer for native and compat views. Interrupt disabled state is derived from the flags interrupt enable bit.

Kernel stack introspection checks whether an address shares the thread sized region of the frame stack pointer, computes the address of the indexed stacked word with null on escape, fetches that word with zero on fault or absence, and resolves call arguments from registers with spill to stacked words beyond the register argument count. The register argument count differs by word size.

Single step support and user single step reporting are advertised as present. Block step is either unconditionally present or conditioned on processor family at least six depending on build. The maximum register offset is the offset of the stack segment slot within the trap frame.

Paravirtual clock ABI uses a packed 32 byte per CPU time record with version, cycle stamp, system time base, fractional multiplier, shift and flags, plus a packed wall clock record with version and seconds plus nanoseconds. A cache aligned wrapper holds one per CPU record.
Paravirtual clock flag bits mark stable timestamp counter, stopped guest, and counting from zero. The size of the aligned per CPU wrapper is exposed as a constant.

Time reads use a sequence protocol where begin masks the low version bit with ordering before data and retry orders after data and signals instability on version change. Delta scaling shifts the cycle delta then multiplies by the fractional factor with word size specific arithmetic, and cycle conversion adds the scaled delta to the base system time.

Queued spinlock pending acquisition is bounded by a retry constant and combines an atomic bit test with acquire semantics and the remaining lock word state. Paravirtual unlock tries a fast atomic compare exchange of the locked value and falls back to a callee saved slow path preserving argument registers on contention.

Real mode coordination uses a header of offsets for text, read only end, trampolines, page table, wakeup and restart entries with optional secure and power management members. The trampoline header differs by word size, holding start plus descriptor fields on 32 bit and start plus extended feature, control, flags and lock on 64 bit.
A real mode flag bit marks secure memory encryption as active.

Real mode area sizing returns zero when already allocated and otherwise the page aligned span of the embedded blob. Installation records the header by converting the supplied physical address to a kernel virtual address.

Machine lifecycle is a table of restart, halt, power off, shutdown, crash shutdown with register frame, and emergency restart operations. Reboot selectors distinguish BIOS and APM paths, and a callback type observes non maskable shutdown with CPU identifier and register frame.
Resource control per CPU state tracks current and default reservation and monitoring identifiers.

Allocation and monitoring capability queries reflect global capability flags, while enable and disable helpers manipulate paired static branch controls for the specific feature and the aggregate enable.

Scheduling installs identifiers by preferring task assigned values when the corresponding feature branch is likely taken and falling back to CPU defaults, writing the combined association to the quality of service register only on change. Monitoring values are quantized to hardware granularity from cache occupancy scale. Helpers set CPU defaults, set and match task values, gate scheduling on aggregate enable, and encode or decode the monitoring index as the reservation identifier with empty class.

Model specific register write fencing conditionally emits memory and load fences unless the platform guarantees fence free APIC access. Read modify write construction provides memory clobber handling and unary generation that captures condition codes from inline assembly on a memory operand.

Stack word fetch is fail safe with zero on region escape or fault proof copy failure. Narrow segment high bits on 32 bit traps must not be trusted. Flexible delivery always presents an error slot whose content is ignored on extended return, with extra exception state defined only on flexible systems.
Each examined header defines an include guard macro to prevent multiple inclusion.
